title: Check which GPU backend Wayland is using
summary: Wayland compositors use different backends (GBM or EGLStreams) to talk to your GPU. This command shows which one is currently active in the system logs.

steps.explain: Search the current boot's journal for lines mentioning 'renderer for'. This usually indicates the backend used by the compositor.
steps.expect: Output lines showing the renderer, e.g., 'renderer for ...: gbm' or 'eglstreams'.
